basic_details.job_title: Delhi University Project Technical Support I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Delhi University has notified 1 vacancy for the Project Technical Support-I post on a project-based engagement sanctioned for a period of 2.5 years. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 18,000 + 30% HRA = Rs. 23,400 PM as per ICMR guidelines. The required qualification is High school + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent)/Intermediate + 2 years experience working as a laboratory attendant/office helper in a molecular biology laboratory OR 3 years of a graduate degree in a biology + 1 year of experience. Eligible candidates can apply by sending their application with an updated resume via email

how_to_apply: Prepare your application along with an updated resume.
Send the application via email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Shashank Kumar Maurya, at the email address [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches within 30 days of the publication of the advertisement, with the final deadline set for 5 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Project Technical Support-I at a Glance

rows.details: Assessing the Neuroprotective Mechanism of ........................... in Type 2 Diabetes – A Proof-of-Concept Investigation
Rs. 18,000 + 30% HRA = Rs. 23,400/- PM as per ICMR guidelines

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil one of the following educational and experience criteria to be eligible for the Project Technical Support-I position: High school plus a Diploma (MLT, DMLT, ITI, or equivalent), OR Intermediate plus 2 years of experience working as a laboratory attendant or office helper in a molecular biology laboratory. Alternatively, 3 years of a graduate degree in a biology discipline plus 1 year of experience working as a laboratory attendant or office helper in a molecular biology laboratory.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 18,000 along with 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA), making a total of Rs. 23,400/- per month as per Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) guidelines. The position is sanctioned under an ad hoc research project for a total period of 2.5 years.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received within the stipulated deadline will be reviewed by the Principal Investigator. Shortlisted candidates will be officially called for an interview. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 5 November 2026, which is within 30 days of the advertisement's publication.

faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through an initial shortlisting of applications followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.
